d: Jet black hair is styled in a short, choppy cut with long side-locks and sharp bangs. The eyes are a piercing golden yellow with a focused, intense expression on a youthful, mature face. The body has a slender, athletic build, clad in a sleek bodysuit of black and white with a high-collared chest piece and a long white split-front skirt. Signature details include black mechanical armor plating on the arms and legs, as well as small, dark horn-like protrusions extending from the head.
